_note: TYPE 1, THE FIX-UP, the first beats Delve: three broken things at a peopled POI, repaired in ANY ORDER
behind one counted objective. Built by Eliza 2026-10-08 on his "yeah build that now"; every player-facing
word is Jessica's, written 2026-10-08 on his "yeah 2". Each repair sets its OWN stage, in whatever order
the player does them, so no journal line may say first, next or last. His play 17:4x: it completes; the
repaired ones showed their markers again (Eliza's).
2026-10-09: each repair now clears its own marker, and 'recap' is stage 100's line, the last thing the
player reads. The recap below is ELIZA'S PLACEHOLDER, owed to Jessica.
recap: All three water reclaimers at the <Place> are running again, and the crew have their water back.

place._theme: Peopled, so somebody is there to have the broken kit (type 1's row: 'three broken things at a peopled POI'). Keeps the base's own exclusions (no natural sites, no caves).

prose.name: Repairs: Water Reclaimers on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The crew at the <Place> have three water reclaimers down and nobody spare to look at them. I said I'd go and get them running.

beats.objective: Repair the water reclaimers at the <Place>
beats.journal: The faulty reclaimer had a clogged intake filter. I've swapped in a clean one and it's drawing water again.
beats.name: Faulty Water Reclaimer

beats.journal: The leaking reclaimer only needed its hose clamps tightened. It's holding pressure now.
beats.name: Leaking Water Reclaimer

beats.journal: The stalled reclaimer had a seized pump. I've freed it, reset the breaker, and it's running.
beats.name: Stalled Water Reclaimer

broadcast: Three reclaimers down and nobody spare to look at them. If you can get them running, there's pay in it.
